tagline.en_US: Dockur image running QEMU/KVM with a browser console. macOS is a virtual machine, not a Linux container; installation must be completed in the web viewer. Installing Apple's macOS requires accepting its end-user license agreement; install it at your own responsibility.

description.en_US: macOS is Apple's desktop operating system, providing a graphical user interface and a Unix-based environment. It enables running Mac-specific desktop software, command-line utilities, and development tools. It is useful for testing, building software, and accessing a macOS environment remotely.

tips: In the macOS recovery menu, open Disk Utility, select the largest Apple Inc. VirtIO Block Media disk, and click Erase to format it to APFS.
After formatting, exit Disk Utility and choose Reinstall macOS, selecting the newly created disk.
During post-installation setup, select Not now on Migration Assistant, choose Set Up Later and Skip on the Apple ID screen, then set a username and password.
